apps.title: Cardputer TV
apps.summary: Cardputer Zero 轻量视频播放器，支持自定义源及帧率设置；订阅兼容性仅做有限样本测试。
apps.description:
Cardputer TV 是面向 M5Stack Cardputer Zero 的轻量视频播放器，适配设备自带 320×170 屏幕、键盘和扬声器。

【功能】
• 自定义播放源：支持 M3U/M3U8 频道列表、频道 JSON、兼容的 HTTP(S)/HLS 媒体地址，以及部分 TVBox 配置中的直播列表。
• 单路播放：切换频道时先结束旧播放，再加载新频道；等待时保留最后一帧并显示“正在加载”，不进行双路预加载。
• 音量控制：播放中每次增减 5%，屏幕显示实际音量百分比。
• 帧率设置：20 / 30 / 60 帧可选，默认 20 帧；保存后下次开始播放生效，重启应用后保留。

【订阅源兼容性说明｜测试范围有限】
订阅源尚未经过充分测试。目前仅做了有限样本验证，真机实播以少量直播频道为主，尚未对各家订阅服务、不同格式变体和 TVBox 配置开展广泛兼容性测试。不能保证所有订阅源都能解析、列出频道或正常播放；部分源可能需要特定请求头、访问条件或不受支持的解析方式。请以自己的实际测试结果为准。

【从电脑导入源文件】
可先在电脑上编辑 UTF-8 的 sources.json，再通过 SFTP 或 ADB 传到运行应用用户的 ~/.config/cardputer-zero-iptv/sources.json，重新打开应用读取。请先退出应用并备份原配置；覆盖文件会替换整个源列表，不会自动合并。~ 指应用用户的主目录，实际用户名以设备为准，配置文件建议权限 600。
也可以上传 M3U 频道列表或频道 JSON，在 Tab 源管理中按 N 新增，将 URL 填为设备上的绝对路径，保存后选中该源并回车切换。文件内容修改后按 R 刷新。含私人 Token 的配置仅保存在自己的设备，请勿公开。

【按键】
频道列表：F/X 或上下选择频道，长按可加速连续选台，Z/C 或左右翻页，回车播放，Tab 管理源，S 打开播放设置。
播放中：F/X 切换频道，Z/C 调整音量，Esc 停止并返回列表。
播放设置：F/X 或方向键选择帧率，回车保存，Esc 取消。

【片源与隐私】
本应用不附带私人订阅、付费账号或商业频道聚合源，仅提供 Big Buck Bunny 公开测试流。请自行添加有权访问和播放的源。第三方源的内容、可用性和访问条件由其提供者决定；播放时会连接所选源及媒体服务器并消耗网络流量。源配置和帧率偏好保存在设备当前用户目录，升级不会覆盖已有源配置。
不支持 DRM 加密节目、加密订阅解密或需要 jar/spider 执行的点播接口。

【运行要求与性能】
适用于 Cardputer Zero 的原生 Linux/APPLaunch 环境，使用内置屏幕和音频输出，需要读取设备键盘和写入 framebuffer 的权限。依赖 Python 3、Pillow、python3-evdev、FFmpeg 和 pulseaudio-utils，由软件包声明；网络播放需要联网。无需相机、麦克风、额外硬件或应用专属后台服务。
当前使用软件解码。设置帧率是视频输出目标，不保证每个源都达到该帧率，也不代表 LCD 的物理刷新率；高分辨率、高复杂度编码或网络波动会影响连续性。高于片源原始帧率时包含重复帧。
安装脚本仅将本应用启动脚本设为 0755，不修改系统网络或显示模式。

【许可证】
应用代码尚未声明标准开源许可证（NOASSERTION），不新增开源授权。随包文泉驿微米黑字体按 Apache-2.0 分发，许可与署名文件位于 fonts 目录。

【版本 0.1.22】
频道列表支持长按 F/X 快速连续选台。改善嵌套明文订阅列表识别，保留同名频道和分组；订阅兼容性仍只做有限样本测试。

【版本 0.1.20】
将设备启动器菜单名称统一为 Cardputer TV，与商店展示名一致；内部包名仍为 cardputer-zero-iptv，升级保留已有源配置和帧率偏好。继续提供 20 / 30 / 60 帧设置、音量百分比、单路切台及加载提示。

apps.title: Gemini Live
apps.summary: Live speech-to-speech AI voice assistant with streaming transcripts.
apps.description:
Gemini Live turns the Cardputer Zero into a real-time conversational voice assistant powered by the Google Gemini Live API (BidiGenerateContent).

Speak naturally into the built-in microphone and hear spoken replies through the speaker while both sides of the conversation stream live on the 320x170 screen — user prompts anchored on the right and assistant replies on the left, each with an inline voice waveform indicator. Press ESC or key 6 while the assistant is speaking to interrupt the reply and immediately start listening again, or press key 5 to clear the history and start a fresh conversation context.

In Settings, configure your Google AI Studio API key (with a built-in QR code link and Ctrl+V clipboard paste), pick from live-capable Gemini models (including extended-thinking models), select a prebuilt voice (Kore, Puck, Charon, Fenrir, Aoede, Leda, Orus, Vesta, Zephyr), and customize the system instructions using the full-screen English/Ukrainian (EN/UA) keyboard editor with Sym, Shift, Fn, Ctrl, Alt layer highlights and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V clipboard support.

apps.summary: NFC/UHF scan, saved dumps, NTAG emulation and RFID tools
apps.description:
RFID 1.0.3 for CardputerZero: READ, SAVED, EMU and TOOLS for M5 NFC CAP (SPI), M5 NFC Unit (IIC), PN532, PN532Killer and compatible UHF readers. Includes saved MFC dump writing, MFKey32v2/MFKey64/Staticnested tools and JSON-backed NTAG emulation. Hardware support varies by function; an external reader is required.

1.0.3 restores the panel mode from the board firmware at startup, after CAP operations and on clean exit; Gen1A Saved writes reuse one unlocked session, check every write ACK and finish without read-back verification. Other write modes retain verification. Prefixed dump key export is corrected, and source modules/tests/build tools are reorganized.

SPI MFC 1K encrypted emulation remains experimental and disabled by default because restart authentication regression is unresolved. Its kernel helper is not installed by this package. The intermittent panel-mode trigger remains under investigation; this release adds recovery.

apps.title: TalkToMe
apps.summary: Offline neural text-to-speech: type English or Ukrainian, hear it spoken.
apps.description:
TalkToMe turns the Cardputer Zero into a talking device: type text, pick a voice and hear it spoken on the built-in speaker. Synthesis runs entirely on the device with a compact neural TTS engine, so your text never leaves it: no network, no account, no cloud service.

Voices: Linda (English) and Mykyta, Oleksa, Tetiana and Serhiy (Ukrainian). All voices ship with the app and nothing is downloaded at run time.

Numbers, dates, times, money and percentages are read out in words with correct grammar, in Ukrainian down to case endings and word stress. Ukrainian text is shown with the stress the voice used.

Keys: Enter opens the text editor with an on-screen keyboard map, Alt switches between English and Ukrainian input, Enter speaks and Esc stops. Space reads a random sample line. In the editor, hold Fn+Z/C to move by character, Fn+Ctrl+Z/C by word and Fn+F/X to jump to the start or end. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste through the system clipboard.

Telega is an unofficial Telegram client built for the Cardputer Zero keyboard and 320x170 screen. Sign in by scanning a QR code with the Telegram app on your phone, or with a phone number and login code.

The chat list follows your Telegram folders (New, All and your own tabs), shows pinned, muted and unread state, and searches by name as you type. Open a chat to read history with read ticks and day separators, reply, react, delete, view and save photos, send images from the device, and record or play voice messages on the built-in microphone and speaker. Forum groups open as a list of threads.

Typing uses a full-screen editor with an on-screen keyboard map: Alt switches between English and Ukrainian (transliterated from the Latin keys), SYM lights up the symbols each key will type, Fn+Z/C and Fn+F/X move the cursor, and Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V go through the system clipboard. Every screen lists its keys at the bottom, and Fn+J saves a screenshot.

Telega is not affiliated with Telegram. It is built on TDLib and uses its own application credentials; your account data stays on the device in your home directory.

apps.title: TrailMate
apps.summary: Reticulum-powered decentralized communication, offline maps and trail sharing.
apps.description:
Your identity belongs to you. Keep private records local. Choose what to share.

TrailMate is an open-source outdoor project built around privacy, self-owned identity and control over local data. With Reticulum at the core of its decentralized collaboration, it combines communication, offline maps, track recording, Team coordination, Geocaching and trail sharing. It now officially supports Cardputer Zero. Paired with a Cap LoRa-1262, this compact keyboard computer becomes a portable radio and mapping terminal, and an entry point into the wider TrailMate ecosystem.

RETICULUM AND PERSONAL AUTONOMY

Reticulum puts the ability to build, operate and interconnect communication networks in the hands of individuals and communities. TrailMate puts that philosophy into practice: devices hold identities and keys; contacts, conversations and unshared tracks stay on hardware and storage the user controls; and users decide which trails or Geocaches to publish.

The companion Web tools require no real-name, phone-number or email account. On devices supporting author authorization, keys and signatures establish who published content. Reticulum gateways and content directories can run independently on different nodes. Users can choose services or participate in building their own, without one operator needing to hold their identity and complete private activity history. Signed publications preserve author and version information, while portable files and backups remain in the user's hands.

COMMUNICATION IN THE FIELD

Reticulum/LXMF provides decentralized private messaging and service collaboration. Cardputer Zero can discover peers and exchange private messages over LoRa, with received messages and delivery state visible on the device. TrailMate also supports basic Meshtastic and MeshCore communication for compatible existing networks. Contacts, broadcasts, private conversations, local message history, live inbox updates, unread indicators and notification sounds are integrated into the interface. Optional private-message auto-replies activate only while the screen is asleep.

OFFLINE MAPS AND YOUR OWN JOURNEYS

Prepare regional maps and resources before departure, then continue viewing surroundings, routes, waypoints and local records without Internet access. OSM maps show roads, paths, buildings and points of interest; terrain maps help explain landforms and elevation; satellite imagery provides a visual reference for the ground. Prepared contour and terrain data extend the available layers. Routes, photo locations and Geocaches can be displayed in their geographic context.

Capabilities include offline place and POI search, KML route import, waypoint and recorded-track display, route previews, elevation profiles and associated photographs. Appropriate region packages containing routing graphs additionally support offline route calculation and navigation. Available layers, search and routing depend on the data prepared for the region.

CREATE MAPS ONLINE, TAKE THEM OFFLINE

Cardputer Zero can create TMAP maps while connected to the Internet. Search administrative areas or place names worldwide, or specify coordinates, then select map content and detail. The device handles acquisition, conversion and production, with progress, cancellation and error feedback. Completed maps can be opened directly. Trail Mate Center provides the companion desktop workflow for larger regions and more involved preparation.

TEAM COORDINATION

Team is a core part of the project's outdoor collaboration model for hiking, camping and small-group activities. It brings members, map positions, shared markers and action messages together. The project supports temporary teams and membership, leader/member roles, shared positions and assembly points, structured rally/move/hold messages, team-scoped communication protected by team keys, and activity records for later review. Team messages are managed separately from ordinary broadcasts and private conversations. Team support on Cardputer Zero will continue to be completed in subsequent updates.

DECENTRALIZED GEOCACHING

TrailMate combines Reticulum, independently operated directories and signed publications for Geocaching. Authors publish caches; others discover them through directories, read descriptions and locations, and save the information needed for offline maps. Companion Web tools provide creation, editing, publication, updates and archiving. Device authorization and signatures establish authorship, while directories help people find content. A service operator does not need to become the custodian of an author's identity and complete private activity history.

DECENTRALIZED TRAIL SHARING

Keep track recordings private, or choose a route to publish. The Tracks workspace combines a personal trail library, shared-trail discovery and publication maintenance. Import KML, KMZ or supported device recordings; organize geometry, segments, waypoints, metadata and attachments; inspect elevation and timing; then decide what to share.

Shared content is signed with a device identity. Updates can preserve the same object identity and link to the previous signed version, allowing recipients to verify the author and update chain. Independent directories provide discovery by map extent and administrative area. Save the content you need as local resources for later offline use. The handheld uses local routes and maps; the companion Web and Reticulum services provide signed publication, shared discovery and version maintenance.

THE DEVICE, WEB AND DESKTOP ECOSYSTEM

The device owns identity, field communication and local records. Browser tools provide more room for editing and organization, while Trail Mate Center prepares maps and supports desktop data management, replay and export. The Cardputer Zero application also includes satellite status, Agenda, Music, a scientific calculator and widget screens for recent messages, GNSS, music and everyday controls.

Project website: https://vicliu624.github.io/trail-mate/
Device management: https://vicliu624.github.io/trail-mate/device/
Tracks workspace: https://vicliu624.github.io/trail-mate/tracks/
Geocaching: https://vicliu624.github.io/trail-mate/geocaching/
Trail Mate Center: https://github.com/vicliu624/trail-mate-center
Source and releases: https://github.com/vicliu624/trail-mate
Documentation: https://github.com/vicliu624/trail-mate/wiki
Physical-device demonstration: https://youtu.be/eBIRhOy7cJc

Published routes, coordinates and Geocaches remain public content; deciding what to share remains the user's choice. LoRa and GNSS require the external Cap LoRa-1262. Map creation and online directories require appropriate network access. Screenshots are native 320 x 170 captures from the physical Cardputer Zero, including explicitly labelled demonstration data. TrailMate is open source under AGPL-3.0 and welcomes users and developers who want to help improve it.

zh-CN.title: TrailMate
zh-CN.summary: 以 Reticulum 为核心的去中心化通信、离线地图、队伍协作与轨迹分享。
zh-CN.description:
身份属于你。私人记录留在本地。由你决定分享什么。

TrailMate 是一个围绕隐私、身份自主权和本地数据所有权构建的开源户外项目。它以 Reticulum 为去中心化协作的核心，将通信、离线地图、轨迹记录、Team 队伍协作、Geocaching 和轨迹分享结合起来。现在，TrailMate 正式兼容 Cardputer Zero；搭配 Cap LoRa-1262，这台小型键盘电脑可以成为随身无线通信与地图终端，也是连接 TrailMate 生态的一个入口。

RETICULUM 与自主权

Reticulum 倡导让个人和社群能够自行建立、运行并互联通信网络。TrailMate 将这种理念落实为：设备持有身份和密钥；联系人、会话和未分享的轨迹保存在自己控制的硬件与存储中；由使用者决定发布哪些路线或寻宝点。

配套 Web 工具不要求注册实名、手机号或邮箱账号。在支持作者授权的设备上，密钥和签名用于确认内容由谁发布。Reticulum 网关与目录可以由不同节点独立运行，使用者可以选择服务，也可以参与建设自己的服务，不必由一个运营者同时掌握身份和全部私人活动历史。公开内容保留作者签名与版本关系，本地文件和备份仍由使用者掌握。

户外通信

Reticulum/LXMF 提供去中心化私聊与服务协作。Cardputer Zero 可以通过 LoRa 发现对端、交换私聊消息，并显示收到的消息和送达状态。TrailMate 同时支持 Meshtastic 和 MeshCore 的基础户外通信，以接入已有的兼容网络。联系人、广播、私聊、会话历史、实时消息更新、未读状态和提示音均整合在设备界面中。可选的私聊自动回复仅在息屏时触发。

离线地图与自己的行程

提前准备区域地图和资源后，在没有互联网的环境中仍可查看周边、路线、航点和本地记录。OSM 展示道路、步道、建筑与地点，地形图帮助理解地貌与起伏，卫星影像提供地表参照。准备好的等高线与地形数据可扩展图层；路线、照片位置和寻宝点可以叠加在地图上。

地图能力包括离线地点与 POI 搜索、KML 路线导入、航点和记录轨迹展示，以及路线预览、海拔剖面和关联照片。包含对应路网的区域地图还可用于离线路径计算与导航。可用的图层、搜索和路径规划能力取决于准备好的地图数据。

联网制作，离线携带

Cardputer Zero 可以直接联网制作 TMAP 地图：搜索全球行政区或地名，也可以指定坐标范围，再选择地图内容和细节程度。设备完成数据获取、转换与制作，提供进度、取消和错误反馈，完成后可以直接查看地图。较大区域和更复杂的地图准备工作可以交给 Trail Mate Center。

TEAM 队伍协作

You are responsible for ensuring that the plugins you use and the music you access are legal in your jurisdiction.

apps.title: ZeroRadio
apps.summary: Pocket radio lab: SDR, scanner, memories, ADS-B, AIS and ISM
apps.description:
ZeroRadio turns the CardputerZero into a pocket receiver. Plug an RTL-SDR dongle (for example the RTL-SDR Blog V4) into the USB-A port and open the hub.

- SDR: spectrum and waterfall up to 2 MHz wide, WFM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB/CW audio on the speaker, squelch, and a frequency correction for the dongle (CAL) shown in ppm and Hz.
- Scanner: sweep a wide band, list the strongest signals at their exact frequency, open one in the SDR with Enter.
- Memories: press M in the SDR or the Scanner to save a frequency, then rename, regroup or delete it, open it in the SDR with its mode, or scan a group and stop where a signal comes in.
- ISM: 433/868 MHz weather sensors, tyre pressure sensors and remotes.
- ADS-B: aircraft list, radar and world map at 1090 MHz.
- AIS: ship list, radar and world map at 162 MHz.

Every decoder runs on the device, with no computer or network. Set your position by city, coordinates or GPS (Cap LoRa-1262-GPS or a USB GPS). Press H in any app for its help. The package bundles readsb and AIS-catcher (GPL-3.0); see Credits in the app.

apps.description:
ZeroSky shows the real sky, live. It computes the stars, constellations, planets, Sun and Moon for the time and your position, and draws them in the direction you point the CardputerZero.

- Sky: 5,070 stars, 605 Messier, NGC and IC objects, constellation figures with their names, and the Solar System. The star limit follows daylight and twilight.

- Find: type a name, and an arrow and rising beeps lead you to the object.
- Camera: draw the sky over the live image and align it with the stars you see.
- Red night theme, blue day theme, location by city, coordinates or GPS.

Everything runs on the device, with no network. Press H for help in seven languages. Pointing accuracy and the camera lens field (an estimated 62.2 degrees) are not yet measured against the night sky.

ZeroTracker is a music tracker for the CardputerZero, inspired by the M8 tracker and compatible with its song (.m8s) and instrument (.m8i) files.

- Eight tracks of songs, chains, phrases, instruments and tables.
- FM, WAV, MACRO (Braids models), HYPER and SAMPLER engines, with modulators, EQ and a sample editor that records from the microphone.
- Mixer with chorus, delay, reverb, master limiter and oscilloscopes.
- RENDER the song to WAV: the mix and a stem per track.
- LIBRARY: download packs of songs, instruments and samples on the device.
- Seven languages, themes, and a tooltip for every key (SYM + 4..8).

At the first start it creates ~/ZeroTracker with a demo song, instruments and a CC0 sample kit. APP > MANUAL shows a QR code to the getting-started guide. Not affiliated with Dirtywave.
